column1: # The top of the objects' tree a source keeps (spec/client/core/sys/io/file.json5 `top`):
# each case's writes, `<octkey, asset_id>` applied in order to an empty tree, and the rows they
# fold to, `<shard's quadkey, fold word>` by shard. Read by the core's store
# (pxl-core domain/layer/object/repository.test.rs) and by the client's source
# (ts/client/src/service/sys/fs/object_tree.test.ts), which folds as the store does.
# the kind most filled, either side of sea level, a marker filling none, two shards
# ties at an even zoom and an odd, air among them
# a leaf split by a finer write, then a quarter erased
# a coarse write over finer ones
# a marker alone folds to nothing, and all erased is no row
